title: Crypto misuse: failed sess_reset leaves iv_set=true with undefined crypto state
description: In src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c ioctl_reset() (~line 1218): if ops->sess_reset() returns non-zero (error), the function returns that error and skips the state cleanup block. iv_set, finalized, error are NOT cleared. For wolfssl AES-CBC: wolfssl_aes_cbc_sess_reset() can fail after calling wc_AesFree() but before successfully calling wc_AesSetKey(). The AES struct is freed/uninitialized. iv_set remains true in fd_state. A subsequent write() passes the iv_set check and calls update() which calls wc_AesCbcEncrypt() on an uninitialized Aes struct → undefined behavior. Fix: on sess_reset failure, set state->error=true so subsequent writes return -EIO rather than proceeding with corrupt state.
